newsitem.title: USA: Santa Anita says still has potential buyers.
newsitem.headline: Santa Anita says still has potential buyers.

text.p: Santa Anita Cos said Monday its directors are continuing negotiations with selected potential buyers in a process designed to maximize value for all Santa Anita shareholders despite Koll/Apollo/Colony's withdrawal from negotiations.

"Maximizing the value of the Santa Anita Cos is the objective of Santa Anita's boards of directors and we are convinced that the process we are pursuing is the best means of meeting that objective," the company said in a statement.

"Santa Anita explained to Koll/Apollo/Colony (KAC) that the process would extend beyond the unilateral deadline established by KAC and we encouraged KAC to continue in the process. We do not expect KAC's withdrawal to affect the ultimate value that will be created for Santa Anita's shareholders," Santa Anita said.
